doc.title: Deploy checklist
doc.content:
Deploy checklist

1. Run the test suite.
2. Tag the release.
3. Announce in the channel.

Rollback is documented in the runbook.

proposal.summary: Added the migration step and pointed rollback at the right runbook.
proposal.rationale: A migration step was missing, and the rollback pointer was vague.
